rationale: SMIB equal-area criterion with Pm=0.9, prefault_pmax=2.0, postfault_pmax=1.5, H=4 s, f0=50 Hz, zero transfer during fault. delta0=asin(Pm/prefault_pmax); delta_max=pi-asin(Pm/postfault_pmax); cos(delta_cr)=(Pm*(delta_max-delta0)+postfault_pmax*cos(delta_max))/postfault_pmax; t_cr=sqrt(4*H*(delta_cr-delta0)/(2*pi*f0*Pm)).
